dossiers.catalyst_stack: Constellium's fundamental momentum is anchored by a record Q1 2026 on 2026-04-29 (segment Adjusted EBITDA of $359M, revenue up 24%, net income of $196M) and an even stronger Q2 2026 on 2026-07-29 (revenue $2,748M, Adjusted EBITDA $439M), with full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance raised to $980M-$1.02B and leverage cut to 1.8x. On 2026-04-21 the company deepened its aerospace franchise via a multi-year Airbus agreement for aluminum alloy extrusions, including Airware aluminum-lithium, from Issoire and Montreuil-Juigné. Deleveraging continued on 2026-06-29 with the sale of the Changchun, China automotive structures joint venture, while a 2026-07-15 10-year renewable solar power agreement for German facilities supports cost and ESG positioning. Offsetting these positives, CSTM fell 4.5% to $25.99 on 2026-09-10 and dropped about 6% on 2026-09-15 as easing aluminum supply concerns pressured the stock, leaving the shares near the low end of their 52-week range despite a $37.20 consensus target.
dossiers.key_assumption: The bullish thesis assumes Constellium's record 2026 EBITDA and raised guidance are sustainable and that the September 2026 aluminum price weakness is a temporary supply-driven pullback rather than the start of a demand-led downcycle; if aluminum prices keep falling or auto/aerospace demand softens, the earnings-beat and guidance-raise catalysts would be invalidated.

dossiers.catalyst_stack: On 2026-07-28, Newsmax entered an AI content partnership with Meta Platforms, giving Meta access to Newsmax's current and archived digital news content — a strategic alliance that monetizes its archive and validates its content library. On 2026-08-06, the FCC voted to end the 39% local TV station ownership cap, a regulatory greenlight that expands Newsmax's broadcast strategy, though on 2026-08-11 CEO Christopher Ruddy said the company is preparing a lawsuit over the cap vote, adding legal uncertainty. On 2026-09-15, Newsmax posted its first quarterly net profit as a public company, beating Q2 estimates with non-GAAP EPS of $0.02 and record revenue of $54.1M, a milestone that confirms operating leverage. With short float at 11.31% and days-to-cover at 6.65, the positive catalyst cluster (Meta deal, FCC ruling, first profit, guidance raise) creates squeeze potential, though the stock remains far below its SMA50 of $16.78 and SMA200 of $38.38.
dossiers.key_assumption: The Meta AI content partnership and FCC ownership-cap ruling translate into durable revenue and distribution expansion, and the Q2 2026 first-profit milestone is repeatable rather than a one-time accounting event.

dossiers.catalyst_stack: On 2026-08-04, Marathon Petroleum reported Q2 2026 net income of $5.1B ($17.73/diluted share) versus $1.2B a year earlier, with revenue of $52.0B beating the $40.9B consensus by $11.1B and EPS beating by $3.46, alongside $8.5B adjusted EBITDA and a 112% capture rate. On 2026-05-05, the company beat Q1 estimates on Iran war-driven refining margins and raised its equity buyback authorization by $5,000M to $55,100M, while on 2026-07-29 the board declared a $1.00/share quarterly dividend payable Sept. 10, 2026. On 2026-08-20, the City of Carson reached a $370M settlement with Marathon resolving a yearslong local tax dispute tied to its West Coast refinery, removing a legal overhang. On 2026-09-15, Raymond James lifted its price target to $445 from $350 amid higher oil prices following a Saudi pipeline shutdown, with U.S. refiner margins spiking to record highs on 2026-07-18 as fuel shortage concerns grew.
dossiers.key_assumption: The bull case rests on sustained wide crack spreads and tight refined-product markets (reinforced by the Saudi pipeline shutdown and record U.S. refiner margins) continuing to drive outsized earnings and cash returns, even as the stock trades near 52-week highs with RSI at 80.42 and a consensus price target ($351.65) below the current price ($397.77).
